CollectionItemFinished: This item is marked as finished.
CollectionItemWatched: This item is marked as finished.
Confirm.Change: Do you want to save the the {name} item changes?
Confirm.CreateNewAccessToken: Do you want to create a new access token?
Confirm.CreateNewUserToken: Do you want to create a new user token? This operation will revoke all existing access tokens.
Confirm.Delete: Do you want to delete the {name} item?
Confirm.DeleteUser: Do you want to delete the user? The operation will irreversibly remove all associated data.
Confirm.ExternalRatingsRefresh: Do you want to refresh external ratings? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings from the configured external metadata provider. That may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImageRefresh: Do you want to refresh images? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh the missing images. That may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImportCollectionData: Do you want to import this collection tracker export? This will replace your current collection data, tag management settings, watchlist, wishlist, watched movies, watching series, books, and related metadata. The imported file becomes your new base state.
Confirm.ImportTagManagementConflicts: Some imported tag management entries already exist. Do you want to overwrite matching entries? Cancel keeps existing entries and imports only new ones.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesUnwatched: Do you want to mark all episodes as unwatched? This will clear the completed episode progress for this series.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesWatched: Do you want to mark all episodes as watched? This will mark every episode in every season as watched.
Confirm.MarkAllMoviesAsUnwatched: Do you want to mark all movies as unwatched? This operation will remove watched copies for movies in the selected library.
Confirm.MarkAllMoviesAsWatched: Do you want to mark all movies as watched? This operation will copy movies from the selected library into Watched.
Confirm.MarkAllSeriesAsUnwatched: Do you want to mark all series as unwatched? This will clear completed episode progress for matching series from the selected library. Tracking items and season metadata are kept.
Confirm.MarkAllSeriesAsWatched: Do you want to mark all series as watched? This operation will copy series from the selected library into Watching and fetch season metadata for newly added series.
Confirm.RefreshSeriesMetadata: Do you want to refresh season metadata from the configured external metadata provider? Existing manual changes will be replaced.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedBookData: Do you want to remove all book data? This deletes every book in Collection for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedMovieData: Do you want to remove all finished movie data? This deletes every Finished movie item for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedSeriesData: Do you want to remove all tracking series data? This deletes every Tracking series item, season metadata, and completed episode progress for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveSeriesMetadata: Do you want to remove season metadata and use the default season and episode options?
Confirm.RemoveShare: Do you want to remove this share?
Confirm.RenameTag: Do you want to rename {oldTag} to {newTag}? If {newTag} already exists, both tags will be merged and the existing {newTag} settings will be kept.
Confirm.ResetTagManagement: Do you want to reset tag management to default? This operation will remove all custom tag colors and display rules.
Confirm.RevokeAccessToken: Do you want to revoke the selected access token?
Confirm.RevokeShare: Do you want to revoke this incoming share?
DragToClose: Drag down or press Enter to close

Message.AccessTokenCreated: Here is your new access token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.AccessTokenSettings: The access token settings allow you to configure the authentication tokens used by the application.
Message.AddFirstBooks: Add a book to your collection.
Message.AddFirstCollectionItem: Add your first movie or series.
Message.AddFirstFinished: Add a movie or book you finished.
Message.AddFirstTracking: Add a series or book you are tracking.
Message.AddFirstWatched: Add a movie or book you finished.
Message.AddFirstWatching: Add a series or book you are tracking.
Message.AddFirstWatchlist: Add a movie, series, or book to Up Next.
Message.AddFirstWishlist: Add a movie, series, or book to your wishlist.
Message.AiSearch: This option uses local AI to provide search results based on the collection items content. It may take a few seconds or minutes to get the search results, but it can find relevant items even with typos or when the search query does not exactly match the item attributes.
Message.AnimatedBackground: Enable or disable animated background. This setting impacts your network usage because enabling this option will fill the background with poster images from your collection items.
Message.CollectionDataExport: Export your collection data to a JSON file. You can import it later to restore your collection.
Message.CollectionDataImport: Import a collection tracker export JSON file to replace your current collection tracker data. This overwrites the current collection, watchlist, wishlist, watched movies, watching series, books, tag management, and settings in this account. Your login, access tokens, and shares are kept.
Message.CollectionItemsByIMDbIdImport: Import collection library items from a JSON, Markdown, or text file. The server extracts IMDb IDs from the file, fetches item details from the configured external metadata provider, adds them to your collection library, and skips IMDb IDs that are already in any of your lists. This does not import watchlist, wishlist, favorites, watching/watched metadata, or watched state.
Message.CollectionListDisplay: Choose which collection item metadata appears in the list view.
Message.CreateNewAccessToken: You can create a new access token to grant permissions to external applications.
Message.DefaultLibrary: Choose which library is selected by default when adding new collection items. Shared libraries are listed here only when you have permission to create items in them.
Message.EmptySelectTagsForChart: Please select at least one tag to display the chart.
Message.ExportImport: Use this section to export or import your collection data and tag management settings.
Message.ExportImportTagManagement: Export or import your tag management settings. This includes custom tag colors, weights, and display rules.
Message.Features: Toggle collection hubs. Wishlist and Up Next accept movies, series, and books. Tracking holds in-progress series and books. Finished holds completed movies and books. Books also appear as a filter under Collection.
Message.IMDbRatingFallback: When the selected rating source has no value for an item, show its IMDb rating instead.
Message.ManageTrackerData: Use this section to quickly set the watched status for all items in your collection.
Message.MarkingAllMoviesAsUnwatched: Marking all movies as unwatched, please wait.
Message.MarkingAllMoviesAsWatched: Marking all movies as watched, please wait.
Message.MarkingAllSeriesAsUnwatched: Marking all series as unwatched, please wait.
Message.MarkingAllSeriesAsWatched: Marking all series as watched, please wait.
Message.MissingImages: Image URLs and external ratings are sourced from the configured external metadata provider. This page lets you refresh missing images and refresh IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings for all collection items.
Message.NewBooksItemSearch: Search OpenLibrary by title, author, or ISBN.
Message.NewCollectionItemManual: Enter the item details manually. An IMDb ID is required to identify the item.
Message.NewCollectionItemSearch: Search using a title, IMDb ID, or IMDb URL.
Message.NewCollectionItemSearchHelpStart: Didn't find what you wanted? Search
Message.NewUserTokenCreated: Here is your new user token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.RefreshExternalRatings: Refreshing external ratings, please wait. This process may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Message.RefreshImages: Refreshing images, please wait. This process may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Message.RemovingTrackedBookData: Removing tracked book data, please wait.
Message.RemovingTrackedMovieData: Removing tracked movie data, please wait.
Message.RemovingTrackedSeriesData: Removing tracked series data, please wait.
Message.SensitiveDataStorage: With local storage, your data will be retained after the session ends. In contrast, with session storage, the affected data will be deleted when the session concludes.
Message.SeriesMetadata: Season and episode counts can come from the configured external metadata provider and may be inaccurate. If the collected data is not correct, adjust the series metadata here to control the season and episode options.
Message.SetSeasonMetadata: No season metadata found. Please set the season and episode counts manually.
Message.ShareSettings: Manage collection sharing with other users. Use your share code to let others share with you, or add their share code to grant them access to your collection with specific permissions.
Message.StorageSettings: The storage settings dictate the policies for using browser storage within the application.
Message.TagManagement: On this page you can set border colors for tags. These colors will be used in the collection overview and details view to make it easier to identify items with specific tags. The tags are automatically loaded from your collection, so you can start customizing them right away! You can also choose to use the tag color for the image border in the collection overview. This can help you quickly identify items with specific tags without having to read the tag labels. The weight determines the color usage order when multiple tags are applicable.
Message.Tags: Please use spaces to separate custom tags. Example: #tag1 tag2. Movie, series, favorite, and watched states are managed separately.
Message.TrackerCleanup: Tracker cleanup affects only My library data in your account. It cannot remove or change shared library items.
Message.UserSettings: The user settings allow you to make account-related changes. This includes actions such as changing the login token or deleting the account.
